productClaim: project-scoped browser IDE runtime; not upstream VS Code, Marketplace, Node inspector, or arbitrary language-server compatible

implemented: TypeScript compiler LanguageService in a dedicated same-origin module Worker
JSON-RPC initialize/shutdown lifecycle, request timeout, cancellation, and stale document version rejection
compiler diagnostics, completion, definition, references, hover, signature help, prepareRename, rename, symbols, formatting, quick fixes, and semantic tokens
Monaco providers, versioned markers, and validated multi-file workspace-edit commits
HostProcessTable process isolation with deny-by-default startup permission and deterministic cleanup
limitations: TypeScript and JavaScript only; no rust-analyzer or arbitrary stdio language-server executable
workspace declaration files and a browser baseline library are used instead of unrestricted node_modules filesystem access
external package-not-found diagnostics are suppressed when declarations are unavailable inside the browser workspace

implemented: P-256 signed and SHA-256 integrity-pinned built-in manifest verification
one isolated HostProcessTable Worker per extension
multi-extension command and language contribution registry with collision rejection
persisted deny-by-default command, diagnostics, workspace read, and workspace write grants
capability-brokered document snapshots and workspace edits
extension-local one-shot crash recovery without editor or runtime failure propagation
limitations: no VSIX, Marketplace, arbitrary JavaScript bundle, or upstream VS Code API compatibility
no ambient network, host filesystem, process, clipboard, DOM, or secret capability

implemented: DAP request, response, and event transport in a dedicated HostProcessTable Worker
workspace program/source launch, verified and conditional breakpoints, continue, next, stepIn, stepOut, terminate, and disconnect
threads, workspace source stack location, module scope variables, watch, REPL evaluation, setVariable, stdout, and exception stops
CSP-safe TypeScript AST interpreter with no eval or new Function
1 MB source and 100000 execution-step safety bounds
limitations: bounded JavaScript and TypeScript statement/expression subset; TSX rendering, imports, classes, async execution, and browser DOM are not executed
function bodies and loops execute atomically rather than exposing nested call frames
not a V8 or Node inspector and does not attach to the live Vite or Next.js preview process

securityBoundaries.csp: same-origin module Workers with no unsafe-eval, eval, new Function, blob script, or remote worker source
securityBoundaries.filesystem: validated file:///workspace URI documents and explicit controller edits only; no host filesystem handles
securityBoundaries.network: no language, extension, or debugger network capability
securityBoundaries.process: scoped browser guest Worker processes only; no host OS process spawn
securityBoundaries.secrets: not exposed to language, extension, or debugger Workers
